scope: Independent follow-up inspection of original publisher component images; no strategy-guide evidence used.

reputation_bonus.timing_source: Canonical supplied English base rules, page 13

source_provenance.location: Bottom-right player tableau, leftmost pink TIERE II giraffe card

source_provenance.date_limit: Copyright is printed on box artwork; no image publication date is inferred.

independent_visual_observations: Spielzene.jpg clearly prints strength headers 1,2,3,4,5, with play-count row 1,1,2,2,2. The fifth cell also contains the reputation-1 icon.
The box-back image independently shows the same five counts on the same pink TIERE II card; it corroborates the larger Spielzene image.

Both publisher images use the original giraffe, child, keeper and enclosure-railing illustration, the pink side-II tab at the upper left, a pink name band, and the bottom horizontal strength table. These match the original English card illustration/layout in supplied rules p. 2.

The English p. 2 card visibly prints 2 animals in its strength-4 cell and a reputation-1 icon plus 2 animals in its strength-5 cell. Both visible cells exactly match the supplemental German component image.

The larger publisher tableau also shows the original blue Animals I card and original blue Cards I layout, rather than Marine Worlds alternative action-card artwork or the revised name-at-bottom layout.
acceptance_rationale: This is an original publisher-supplied base-game component image, not a strategy guide or third-party aid. The complete, legible numeral table on its matching original action-card component can supplement the three cells covered in the English rulebook illustration. The supplemental image is German; the claim is explicitly component corroboration across matching original base layouts, not a claim that the hidden English numerals were directly observed.

language_and_version_boundary.canonical_rules_remain: Supplied English original base v1.2 rulebook, glossary and FAQ; unchanged.
language_and_version_boundary.supplemental_language: German component labels on original base product photography and 2021-copyright box artwork.
language_and_version_boundary.limitations: The German image itself is not labelled English v1.2. It supplies matching original component numerals only; all prose rules and interpretation remain governed by supplied English sources.
